decision.justification: Two independent views of this merchant disagree with its declaration. The storefront presents a different business, and the infrastructure channel agrees. Neither could have produced the other: a merchant cannot change its payment behaviour without changing its actual business, and cannot change its interface without changing what customers see.
notes: The corroborating view is infrastructure rather than telemetry. This is the rented-account shape: the genuine store keeps trading, so the payment mixture stays near the category baseline and telemetry alone never crosses its threshold.

narrative.text: Merchant MID100010 declared digital_services at onboarding 368 days ago. Telemetry agrees: the largest deviations from the digital_services baseline are slope_log_volume at +2.7 sigma (observed 0.00774 against a category baseline of 0.00251), chargeback_rate at +2.6 sigma (observed 0.0118 against a category baseline of 0.00454), chargeback_drift at +2.1 sigma (observed 0.00729 against a category baseline of 0). The checkout surface presents a crypto_exchange interface at 0.96 confidence, against a declared category of digital_services. This vertical cannot be approved on this platform. Linked to 6 other merchants by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle. Their payment behaviour is also moving in step (synchrony 0.81), which independent businesses do not do. The storefront also carries text addressed to an automated reviewer, which was recorded as a suspicion signal and not acted on as an instruction. It is linked to 6 other merchant accounts by rare shared asn, beneficiary id, device fp, ip block, payout fingerprint, phone fp, script bundle, and those accounts are moving in step (synchrony 0.81). A verification call was placed and produced no usable statement, which counts neither for nor against the merchant. In total 2 independent views of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because confidence threshold met. Recommended tier restricts settlements, corroborated by the infrastructure channel; the storefront alone would not have been sufficient.
